title: Mind Body Intervention for Chronic Lower Back Pain
brief_summary: This pilot study will evaluate the feasibility of having a non-behavioral health provider deliver a combination of manual therapy (MT) and cognitive behavioral therapy for pain (CBT-p). In addition, we will evaluate differences in outcomes in patients undergoing the combined intervention of CBT-p and MT and those undergoing MT alone.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 to 69 years of age with CLBP who are
* "high risk" for poor prognosis based on SBST
* currently undergoing chiropractic care.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindications to either MT or CBT-p.
* Patients who are currently undergoing CBT-p
* who have been treated for substance abuse in the past year.
